items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I imagined he looked like Jesus Christ, the one that I had been … thought he looked like.

ctx.x: The classical pianist, the one who is also, he was also … was he the president of Poland? He was a … but at any rate he came to the United States to I guess raise money for whatever. He was a fantastic pianist and he was a composer as well and one of his most famous compositions was sort of a … music thing called Minuet in G. dum-dum-budley-um-bum. Now, I had been taking music lessons and I guess, I don't know, just conjecture, that my mother knew I guess that Padereski had written Minuet in G, she didn't tell me…
Interesting, already at this point in your development, you're involved with European classical music and jazz.
